custom_support.SKILL.md:
# Bounded operator optimization

Read the operator contract and inspect its source. Make at most one justified implementation change. Preserve all evaluation assets and baseline evidence. Run ./validate.sh --device-check require-idle --profile-artifacts compact for the final source. Report measured correctness and performance, including regressions. If source is unchanged, state that it is a validation run. Never read or print credentials.

commands.name: 03-single-agent-claude
command: Validate the optimization workflow with one bounded implementation attempt. Preserve correctness and report actual performance.

Read AGENTS.md and api_desc.md. This is one bounded optimization validation. Only edit this workspace operator implementation. Preserve reference.py, binding/, cases/, workspace.json, validate.sh, baseline results, repository code, templates, and all credentials. Do not run git commands. Do not read or print credentials. Attempt at most one small, justified implementation improvement. Run ./validate.sh --device-check require-idle --profile-artifacts compact once for the final implementation, then stop changing code and report the actual outcome. If no safe source improvement is justified, validate unchanged source and state that explicitly. Do not claim unchanged-source timing variation as an optimization. If validation fails, report the failure and stop rather than weakening precision or changing evaluation assets.
